tasks.title: Create artifact module scaffold
tasks.description: Create the src/artifacts module structure and export a discriminated union for all v1 artifact types from the specification.
tasks.deliverable: Typed artifact definitions in src/artifacts/types.ts and src/artifacts/index.ts
acceptance_criteria: All v1 artifact types are represented in TypeScript
Artifacts share a common discriminant field for artifact_type
Modules compile without placeholder import errors

tasks.title: Implement runtime schema validation
tasks.description: Add runtime validators for each artifact shape so persisted artifacts can be validated on write and read.
tasks.deliverable: Artifact schema validators with happy-path and invalid-shape coverage
acceptance_criteria: Every v1 artifact has a validator
Invalid artifacts fail with clear errors
Spec-derived fixture examples validate successfully

tasks.title: Build artifact ID and path helpers
tasks.description: Implement ID generation helpers and deterministic path mapping from artifact type to .pi/artifacts storage directories.
tasks.deliverable: Reusable ID generator and artifact path utility layer
acceptance_criteria: Artifact IDs are unique and type-aware in shape
Each artifact type maps to a stable on-disk directory
Helpers are reusable by store and services

tasks.title: Implement artifact store
tasks.description: Create a JSON-backed artifact store with typed get, put, exists, and listByType operations under .pi/artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts can be persisted and reloaded by ID
Typed retrieval validates artifact_type on read
listByType returns stored artifacts for a type

tasks.title: Add session state model
tasks.description: Implement lightweight session state persistence for current stage, current artifact IDs, and lineage metadata.
tasks.deliverable: Session state read/write helpers and restart-safe state model
acceptance_criteria: Session state can be initialized and reloaded
Current stage and artifact pointers persist across restarts
State model can represent lineage/history

tasks.title: Create conductor stage-machine skeleton
tasks.description: Add a minimal stage-machine shell and prompt constants so the extension has a real conductor runtime spine without implementing full workflow logic yet.
acceptance_criteria: Stage machine exposes current stage and transition helpers
Prompt constants are centralized for later phases
No raw repo-read capability is added to conductor logic

tasks.title: Replace no-op extension bootstrap
tasks.description: Modify the extension entrypoint to initialize the runtime, artifact store, and session state, and wire placeholder service hooks.
tasks.deliverable: Non-no-op extension bootstrap that safely initializes conductor runtime
acceptance_criteria: Extension boot initializes runtime state without errors
Store and session state are available from extension startup
No raw repo file tools are exposed through conductor bootstrap

tasks.title: Add stub service contracts
tasks.description: Create typed placeholder service modules for intent expansion, retrieval dispatch, evidence preparation, synthesis dispatch, execution dispatch, and artifact promotion.
tasks.deliverable: Stable service interfaces for later implementation phases
acceptance_criteria: Each planned service has typed input/output contracts
Stub services return explicit not-implemented or fixture-backed results
Later phases can build on interfaces without breaking callers

tasks.title: Add test runner and package scripts
tasks.description: Introduce a test runner and package scripts so schema, store, and session-state tests run locally and in CI.
tasks.deliverable: Runnable test command wired into package.json and CI if needed
acceptance_criteria: npm test executes the new test suite
Core Phase 1 tests run in CI or documented local workflow
Project remains installable via existing scripts

tasks.title: Implement Stage 1 intent capture and restatement loop
tasks.description: Create the strict approval loop for intent capture, simple restatement, correctness check, and expansion yes/no question.
tasks.deliverable: Working Stage 1 interaction flow producing intent-capture-v1 and intent-restatement-v1
acceptance_criteria: Conductor emits the required canonical restatement message shape
Approval turns are tracked
Retrieval cannot proceed before approval

tasks.title: Implement expansion inclusion protocol
tasks.description: Add tagged-file inclusion logic and project-doc discovery/prompting for README.md, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md when no files are tagged.
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic expansion-input creation with enforced inclusion rules
acceptance_criteria: All tagged files are auto-included
Project-doc question appears only when required
Expansion input artifacts are persisted correctly

tasks.title: Implement retrieval dispatch and normalization
tasks.description: Build the retriever worker boundary and normalize its output into retrieval-index-v1 without exposing raw source to the conductor.
tasks.deliverable: Stored retrieval-index-v1 artifacts from approved intent packages
acceptance_criteria: Retriever output validates as retrieval-index-v1
Paths are absolute and line numbers are 1-indexed
No raw full-file payload is surfaced to conductor-safe retrieval fields

tasks.title: Implement evidence plan and deterministic assembler
tasks.description: Add conductor evidence-plan generation and deterministic preview/materialize assembly into evidence-bundle-v1.
tasks.deliverable: Evidence planning plus deterministic evidence bundle materialization
acceptance_criteria: Preview returns stable estimates
Materialize returns valid evidence-bundle-v1
Assembler includes only what the plan requested

tasks.title: Implement synthesis dispatch
tasks.description: Create synthesis prompt assembly and output validation for analysis-report-v1 and change-spec-v1.
tasks.deliverable: Stored synthesis artifacts generated from evidence bundles
acceptance_criteria: Synthesis supports analysis-report and change-spec task types
Outputs are schema-validated before persistence
Prompt assembly uses deterministic bundle sections

tasks.title: Implement execution dispatch and recursive restart
tasks.description: Add local execution from change-spec-v1, execution-report-v1 persistence, and synthesis artifact promotion to recursive-intent-v1 with restart at Stage 1.
acceptance_criteria: Execution dispatch produces execution-report-v1
Promotion creates recursive-intent-v1
Promoted flows restart at Stage 1
